text: Unconstrained mutual funds have not delivered superior performance: Morningstar data for funds with three years of investing history offer no evidence that they outperform mutual funds in comparable asset classifications.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: The Morningstar data available for UMFs with three years of investing history offer no evidence that UMFs have a superior performance to mutual funds in comparable asset classifications.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: unconstrained mutual funds with at least three years of investing history
